race.title: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back EBF 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes
race.verdict: PALMS OASIS gets the nod to make it third time lucky over C&D for the Roger Varian yard. Chapel Down will be a threat if back to the form he showed on his all-weather debut. Al Alami is open to improvement on the back of an encouraging opening run at Kempton. Bondy Boy was prominent in the betting on his intended debut at the abandoned meeting here last Saturday and it'll be interesting to see if his supporters return. PALMS OASIS CHAPEL DOWN AL ALAMI
